Dear FreshFizz Commercial Sales Team,

MegaMart Online is looking to restock our retail distribution centers with your high-demand beverage and snack lines for the upcoming sales quarter. We have reviewed your catalog and would like to request a formal Material Request Quote (MRQ) for the following items:
- SODA-001: 600 units
- CHIP-001: 400 units
- COOK-001: 600 units
- JUIC-001: 1000 units

Please review your stock levels and let us know your standard lead times, minimum order requirements, and any bulk purchase terms that might apply to this order. We look forward to establishing a mutually beneficial supply relationship.

Best regards,

Procurement Director
MegaMart Online

Dear MegaMart Online Procurement Team,

Thank you for your Material Request Quote. We appreciate the opportunity to partner with MegaMart Online for your seasonal retail inventory replenishment.

We have verified our stock levels at our FreshFizz main distribution center. I am pleased to confirm that we have quoted availability based on current inventory, detailed below:
- FizzCola Classic (SODA-001): 600 units quoted @ $1.50/unit (100% fulfilled)
- CrunchySalt Potato Chips (CHIP-001): 400 units quoted @ $2.20/unit (100% fulfilled)
- ChocoDelight Cookies (COOK-001): 460 units quoted @ $3.50/unit (77% fulfilled)
- PureOrange Juice (JUIC-001): 0 units quoted @ $4.20/unit (0% fulfilled)

Our estimated lead time for packing and shipping is 3 business days from receiving your official Purchase Order. Please let us know if this proposal meets your timeline, so we can lock in the shipment slots.

Sincerely yours,

Commercial Sales Director
FreshFizz Consumer Products

content.letter_text:
Dear FreshFizz Commercial Sales Team,

Thank you for providing the initial fulfillment proposal and confirming inventory availability. We are pleased to see that you can fulfill our requested quantities for most items.

Upon reviewing the quoted prices, our finance team has requested that we seek a discount on our highest-volume lines to align with our seasonal budget caps. Specifically, we are proposing a 4% discount on: SODA-001, CHIP-001.

Additionally, we have adjusted the requested quantity for SKU COOK-001 down to 368 units to better balance our stock levels.

We believe this counter-offer is fair and aligns with standard volume discount agreements in the industry. If these terms are acceptable, we are prepared to issue a formal Purchase Order immediately.

Sincerely,

Procurement Director
MegaMart Online

content.letter_text:
Dear MegaMart Online Procurement Team,

Thank you for your feedback and counter-proposal. We appreciate your transparency regarding your seasonal budget constraints. 

After reviewing the proposal with our commercial pricing committee, we have approved the proposed discount terms for accepted lines. However, due to tight margins and rising supply costs, we are UNABLE to approve the discount on CrunchySalt Potato Chips (CHIP-001). Its unit price must remain at the original quoted rate of $2.20.

Please review these final pricing terms. If you accept this final proposal, you may proceed with submitting your PO.

With best regards,

Commercial Sales Director
FreshFizz Consumer Products
